description_en: Queries the deadlock details of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 调用GetDeadLockDetailList接口，查询RDS SQL Server实例的死锁详情列表
kebab_example: aliyun das get-dead-lock-detail-list --instance-id rm-2ze2016723b320000 --start-time 1701755730292 --end-time 1702360530292 --page-no 1 --page-size 5 --db-name-list testdb1,testdb2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDeadLockDetailList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database. When you specify multiple databases, you must separate the database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名。传入多个数据库时，各个数据库名称间使用英文逗号（,）进行分隔
parameters.name: db_name_list
